agents-md.note: AGENTS.md is the attacker's Codex instruction file on the orchestration host, not a file written on a PaperCut server.

exploit.note: GreyNoise and Elastic tie the activity to PaperCut NG/MF CVE-2026-81578 and CVE-2026-82078. Hunt.io describes a second path through XML-RPC method names and does not publish a request body.

creds.note: Hunt.io says the host logged registry-hive dumps. The cited rules match reg.exe hive saves on Windows.

domain.note: Hunt.io says the same logs include directory-replication requests. The cited rules match replication from a user account.

tunnel.note: Hunt.io describes chisel plus a cron entry for a reverse SOCKS5 tunnel. The persistence profile covers the scheduled write. A separate Linux rule covers the chisel client.
